references.text: Describes the earlier part of the crossing of the Jordan, where the priests with the ark stood in the middle of the river while the people crossed over
Shows a similar pattern where the Lord's ark and the priests went ahead of the people, this time around Jericho
The Lord's ark of the covenant went before the people in the wilderness to find a resting place for them
The children of Israel passed through the Red Sea on dry ground, a parallel to the crossing of the Jordan
Moses gave the law to the priests who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant, confirming the priests' role in carrying the ark
Hebrews mentions the significance of faith at the crossing of the Red Sea and the fall of Jericho, both events linked to Joshua's time
